title: Migration 19 — the farm admin field guard
description: Applies migration 19 standalone and rolls it back, scoring VERIFY sections A through F. 19 installs the trigger that pins seven admin-controlled columns on public.farms -- status, compliance_status, export_readiness, partner_tier, risk_level, created_by and reviewed_by -- so a farmer editing their own farm cannot promote it. Section B1 is the one that matters: it performs a farmer UPDATE that sets all seven plus the allowed farm_name, then asserts the seven did not move AND that farm_name DID. That last clause is what makes the section non-vacuous -- if RLS blocks the UPDATE entirely, all seven assertions pass for the wrong reason and only the allowed column reveals it.
